other_conditions: Applicant must not be a defaulter of any bank, financial institution, MFI, NBFC, SFB, or PACS.
Applicant must not be a beneficiary of any other self‑employment scheme of the state or central government.
Family definition: if unmarried, the applicant and dependent parents; if married, the applicant, spouse, and dependent children (no age limit for dependent unmarried children).
benefits_summary: SC beneficiaries receive a 5% annual interest subsidy on term and working‑capital loans for up to seven years, including the moratorium period.
